biography.characterFamilySituation: Orphaned during the second Matrix Crash; raised by an aunt in Seattle
biography.characterEyes: Dark brown (faint resonance shimmer when threading)
biography.characterHair: Black, unkempt, often falling over eyes
biography.description: Kai is wiry and perpetually sleep-deprived, with the kind of gaunt intensity that makes people cross the street. He dresses in thrift-store layers — oversized jackets, cargo pants with too many pockets, and a pair of battered AR gloves that never leave his hands. His eyes occasionally flicker with an inner light when he's reaching into the Resonance, and static discharge crackles across his fingertips when he's stressed. No datajack, no implants — he doesn't need them. The Matrix speaks to him directly.
biography.background: Kai was seven years old when the second Matrix Crash hit Osaka. His parents were both grid-jockeys who died when their neural links overloaded. Something changed in Kai that day — the dying Matrix reached into his mind and left a piece of itself behind. He emerged from the wreckage able to feel data flowing through the walls, hear the whisper of wireless signals, and see the Resonance that underlies all digital reality. His aunt brought him to Seattle, where he grew up on the streets of Tacoma, learning to use his abilities to survive. A technomancer mentor named Binary helped him understand what he was and taught him to compile sprites and thread complex forms. Now he runs the shadows, taking jobs that let him explore the deeper mysteries of the Resonance while keeping GOD off his back. He's drawn to data havens and abandoned hosts, searching for echoes of whatever spoke to him during the Crash.

system.description: The cheapest commlink on the market. Basic functionality, but it gets the job done for someone who doesn't need hardware to access the Matrix.
Augmented reality interface gloves that allow tactile interaction with AR objects. Kai uses them as a focus point for threading complex forms.
A handheld device for analyzing bio-signatures. Useful for security bypass and identifying targets.
A lined coat with reinforced panels. Kai's version is a nondescript dark grey with deep pockets, chosen specifically because it doesn't draw attention.
A standard taser pistol. Non-lethal takedown option for when things get physical — which Kai tries to avoid.
A simple, reliable blade. More tool than weapon, but effective in a pinch.
The character is a technomancer, able to interface with the Matrix through sheer force of will and Resonance.
system.gameEffect: Grants access to the Living Persona, complex forms, sprites, and submersion.

system.description: +2 dice pool modifier to Logic-based tests involving pattern recognition, evidence analysis, clue finding, or puzzle solving.
The character becomes agitated and stressed in crowded social situations, suffering penalties to social tests when surrounded by large groups of people.
The character is unusually thin and gaunt, making them stand out in a crowd. This is a form of Distinctive Style.
system.gameEffect: +2 dice to attempts to identify or find the character in a crowd due to their distinctive appearance.

system.description: A fellow technomancer and Kai's mentor figure. Binary helped Kai understand his abilities and taught him the basics of compiling and threading. They communicate exclusively through the Matrix.
A small-time fixer operating out of Tacoma. Handles jobs for runners who don't mind getting their hands dirty. Reliable but not particularly well-connected.
A well-connected information broker who operates through multiple Matrix personas. Deals in corporate secrets, security intel, and paydata. Expensive but reliable.
A tiny capsule-style room in a run-down coffin hotel in Tacoma. Just enough space for a sleeping pod and a small locker. The walls are thin and the neighbors are loud, but it's cheap and anonymous.
